messages:
jamie: pushed export map changes to @redwood/js-sdk to add conditional fields for node vs edge. sample-app Cloudflare run now errors.

sasha: error log?

jamie: runtime: `ReferenceError: process is not defined` when importing `createClient` in worker. TS says module has no exported member.

noah: can you paste package.json exports?

jamie: current exports:
``n"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": "./dist/node/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
  },
  "./*": "./dist/*"
}
``n
noah: looks like bundler picks default but rollup/worker flow ends up using CJS-ish loader, pulling in node-only bits. also type entry still points at `dist/index.d.ts` which exports named symbols from node build.

tina: quick scan: dist/edge/index.mjs references `process.env.REDWOOD_DEBUG` in a logger guard. that's the culprit for worker error.

sasha: for TS mismatch, we should expose `./types` mapping in exports so TS resolves to the right dts for edge import shape.

jamie: temporary workaround: import the edge bundle directly from package path: `import * as sdk from '@redwood/js-sdk/dist/edge/index.mjs'` — ugly but works.

ci-bot: new CI job proposal: run sample-app smoke with wrangler dev + tsc check on sample against published package.

noah: long term fix: update exports to include `worker` and explicit type mapping, remove `process` usage or guard with typeof, and add lint rule banning process in edge entrypoints. add cloudflare/deno smoke CI matrix.

jamie: I'll draft PR: change exports to include `worker`, `import`, and `require` conditions and add `./types` entry. also will scrub process usage.

sasha: +1, also add note in changelog so customers know about new edge condition.

jamie: assigning followups: jamie PR, noah types CI, tina remove process guards. will link PR here when ready.

sasha: thanks, landed small patch to revert export tweak on canary until PR is ready.

jamie: will update thread with PR link.
